Enumerate every source-stated service occurrence on one stable opaque key. Preserve the explicitly stated worker, employer, literal service or labor kind, dates grammatically attached to that service, express venue cue, geographic location, and country. Paid-to-for-work grammar may establish payer as employer and payee as worker, but payment proximity alone may not. Service dates never become payment dates or kinship periods. Only genuinely stated full dates may be copied and normalized; ambiguous attachment or insufficient temporal granularity is unread. An express 'her home' is a home venue but not a shared residence; domestic service alone does not establish any home or private-home venue. Preserve both purpose_ and type_ factual ports for an explicit service kind. Null closes an optional field only after the corresponding source property was checked. Questions, workday targets, citizenship, and remembered events cannot create values. Return complete or unread with exact facts witnesses, using identical stable keys in every refined read.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
